component.name: Zingo PC
component.summary: Shielded light client wallet for Zcash

description.p: Zingo PC is a fully shielded light client wallet for the Zcash blockchain. It connects to a lightwalletd server so you never need to download the full chain, while keeping your transaction history and addresses private through Zcash's shielded (Sapling and Orchard) protocol.

ul.li: Send and receive shielded (private) Zcash transactions
Full Orchard and Sapling shielded pool support
BIP-39 seed phrase backup and restore
zcash: URI scheme handler for payment requests
Optional Tor support for enhanced network privacy

description.p: Latest stable release of Zingo PC.
